How can we help?

How do I verify my account? +
Verification requires a government-issued ID and a live selfie. Most accounts are verified within 10 minutes.
What are the withdrawal limits? +
Limits depend on your verification tier. Tier 1 allows up to $5,000 daily, while Tier 3 has no set limits.
Is my crypto insured? +
Yes, 98% of assets are held in cold storage, and we carry institutional-grade insurance for our hot wallets.
